sections.content:
You know *apenas*, *en cuanto*, *al cabo de*, *a medida que* and *conforme* from B2 Unit 2, and the pluperfect indicative from B1 Unit 1. In a testimony or chronicle, these connectors do more than link two finished events in the preterite: they pace a journey across months or decades.

1. **Immediate sequence with the pluperfect:** *apenas* + pluperfect + *cuando* (or a comma) shows that a new event broke in right after an earlier one had finished: *Apenas había terminado la travesía cuando tuvo que acudir al consulado.*
2. **Uncounted spans:** *al cabo de* does not require an exact number. Expressions like *al cabo de los años* or *al cabo de un tiempo* compress a whole stage of settlement into one phrase.
3. **Past narrative vs prospective subjunctive:** for events that already unfolded, *conforme*, *a medida que*, *apenas* and *en cuanto* take the indicative. When a chronicle turns to future or pending stages, the same connectors take the subjunctive: *apenas reciban el permiso de residencia*, *conforme vayan llegando más familias*.

sections.title: Chronicle uses of narrative time connectors
rows: Apenas había terminado la travesía cuando buscó alojamiento.
Pluperfect + cuando: second action interrupts immediately.
Al cabo de los años, la acogida del barrio se volvió su hogar.
Uncounted span: compresses a long period.
Conforme pasaban los inviernos, los migrantes conocían mejor la ciudad.
Conforme vayan llegando nuevas familias, el centro ampliará sus talleres.
Apenas obtengan el permiso de residencia, podrán solicitar trabajo formal.

items.spanish: Apenas había bajado del barco cuando una vecina se ofreció a acoger a la familia.
items.english: She had barely stepped off the boat when a neighbour offered to take the family in.

items.spanish: Al cabo de los años, aquel migrante recordaba sobre todo la primera acogida.
items.english: Over the years, that migrant remembered above all the first welcome.

items.spanish: Conforme pasaban los meses, los trámites en el consulado se volvían menos confusos.
items.english: As the months went by, the procedures at the consulate became less confusing.

items.spanish: Apenas reciban el permiso de residencia, podrán inscribirse en la escuela técnica.
items.english: As soon as they receive the residence permit, they will be able to enrol in the technical school.

sections.content: Watch the mood after *apenas*, *en cuanto* and *conforme*: English uses a present tense for future triggers ('as soon as they receive'), so learners often write *apenas reciben el permiso, podrán trabajar*. Whenever the main clause looks ahead to the future, Spanish requires the subjunctive (*apenas reciban*, *conforme lleguen*).
